summary: Practise spatial data checks, QGIS analysis and R workflows. Build maps and reproducible outputs. Explore the 10-day course.
lede: Geospatial analysis with QGIS and R helps GIS analysts, planners and research professionals turn spatial data into checked analyses and decision-ready maps. You will practise validating GeoPackage layers and coordinate reference systems, joining vector data and analysing raster surfaces, then build repeatable R scripts and QGIS map outputs with source notes and documented assumptions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who already use spatial data and need to move between QGIS desktop workflows and analysis in R.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with GIS concepts and basic QGIS operations is expected. You should be comfortable with basic R syntax, data frames and file management. R scripting is required for the course exercises; advanced programming experience is not required. Bring a laptop with QGIS and R installed, subject to the provider's technical setup instructions.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
